title: blood swords
body: The sword gleamed with a deadly mix of diamond-blue and dark netherite black, its edge dripping with fresh crimson blood. Jagged streaks of red crawled along the blade like cracks of fire, staining the once-pristine metal. The hilt was scarred from countless battles, and the air around it felt heavy, as if the weapon carried the souls of every enemy it had struck down. Under the dim light, the blood shimmered against the enchanted steel, making the sword look both powerful and terrifying.
